notes.source: Last pregame snapshot of our sportsbook feed; results from NHL official statistics.
notes.timing: Prices come from the last snapshot we saved before each game, normally our morning refresh of the game day (about 7 to 8:30 AM ET). For the games graded so far that was a median of 6.7 hours before puck drop (range 0.2 to 20.5). Lines often move before games start, especially after starting goalies are confirmed, so this compares results with that snapshot, not the closing line.
